triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Mitya remembered Andrey again, and ordered punch to be sent out to him. “I was rude to him just now,” he repeated with a sinking, softened voice.

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: She was ashamed, and from her eyes he could see now whom she loved.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: If the peasants had asked him for money at that moment, he would have pulled out his notes and given them away right and left.

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: Mitya, Mitya, how could I be such a fool as to think I could love any one after you?

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: Mitya, dumb with rapture, gazed into her eyes, at her face, at her smile, and suddenly clasped her tightly in his arms and kissed her passionately.

triples.subject: Kalganov
triples.quote: “Leave off laughing at Poland,” said Kalganov sententiously. He too was drunk.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: Ex-Lieutenant Karamazov, it is my duty to inform you that you are charged with the murder of your father, Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov, perpetrated this night....

triples.subject: Ex-Lieutenant Karamazov
triples.quote: Ex-Lieutenant Karamazov, it is my duty to inform you that you are charged with the murder of your father, Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov, perpetrated this night....

triples.subject: Ex-Lieutenant Karamazov
triples.quote: I love you. I love only you. I’ll love you in Siberia....

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: I was with some one I loved, with you. And far, far away.

triples.subject: Ex-Lieutenant Karamazov
triples.quote: Grusha, you wanted to be honest, but I’m a thief. But I’ve stolen money from Katya.... Disgrace, a disgrace!

triples.subject: Mihail Makarovitch
triples.quote: Monster and parricide! Your father’s blood cries out against you!” the old captain of police roared suddenly, stepping up to Mitya.

triples.subject: Grushenka
triples.quote: If you love her, I shall strangle her.... I’ll put out both her eyes with a needle....
